comments.note: No security findings — all OWASP Top 10 categories reviewed; no Critical or High issues identified. WP-008 change is purely test-additive: the only modified file is orchestrator/tests/test_nodes.py (TestConfigRetryWiring class). The call-site wiring in src/nodes/__init__.py:884-893 was pre-existing. Config values are validated at parse time (stream_max_retries >= 0, stream_retry_base_delay_s >= 0) with safe fallbacks to defaults, eliminating any misconfiguration risk from env-var injection.

Info — Pre-existing (WP-003): 'error': str(_exc) in the stage_retry JSONL entry (src/nodes/__init__.py:~530) could surface provider-returned error message text in logs. JSON serialization in the JSONL writer escapes special characters, preventing log injection. However, if an API provider embeds contextual data (e.g. account identifiers) in rate-limit error messages, those would appear in run logs. Not introduced by WP-008; recorded for awareness.

Info — Pre-existing (WP-003): _is_retryable_api_error() walks the exception chain recursively (src/nodes/__init__.py:126). Python's exception chain is typically a linear linked list, and circular chains are prevented by the language runtime in most cases. The guard 'cause is not exc' catches the trivial self-loop. No exploitable path identified; recorded for completeness.
